4. There is no reply to the respondent no. 4 though Mr. Vikram Singh submits that he personally delivered the copy to the office of the respondent no. 4 and a receipt of this effect Patna High Court CWJC No.12722 of 2022(4) dt.10-09-2024 was filed on 07.08.2024.
5.

Instead of waiting for the reply of the respondent no. 4, as the writ petition is pending for the last two years, the same is disposed of with an observation that if the petitioner prefers a represention before the respondent no. 4, the Executive Officer, Nagar Panchayat, Simri Bakhtiyarpur, Saharsa,
he is duty-bound to take the same for consideration and pass a speaking order within a period of three months from the date the petition along with the order of this Court is received by his office.

6. The writ petition stands disposed of.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Vijay Singh/-

ORAL ORDER 4 10-09-2024 Heard Mr. Vikram Singh, learned counsel for the counsel and the State.
2. The present writ petition has been preferred for the following relief(s):
 "for issuance of approp  Writ/Order/Direction commanding  Respondents to make payment of arrear of amount since 17.05.2019 to till date as per Patna High Court CWJC No.12722 of 2022(4) dt.10-09-2024 the Agreement/Lease Deed dated 17.05.2019 Yogendra Prasad vs The State Of Bihar on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30814592/
1 executed between the Respondent no.-5 and the petitioner;
(ii) for issuance of appropriate writ/order/direction commanding the Respondents to make payment of statutory and penal interest against the arrear of amount payable to the petitioner;
(iii) for issuance of appropriate writ/order/direction commanding the Respondents to make payment of Compensation payable to the petitioner under the Lease Policy 2014 issued by the Respondents under the Section-104 of the Right to fair Compensation and Transparency in land acquisition and rehabilitation and re-settlement Act 2013;
(iv) for any other relief/ reliefs your Lordship may deems fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."
